verdict.rationale: Buzz is a team chat and workspace product, so a compliance export of workspace message history is a fair question for it. However, no evidence documents an admin-facing export of message history in machine-readable formats, nor policy-governed inclusion of private conversations or DMs. Self-hosted database ownership, Nostr protocol access to relay events, history search, and the moderation admin API are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not an export capability.
